europe_now.title: Europe: Raging wildfires scorch large swaths of the continent
europe_now.summary: Wildfires across Europe have forced evacuations and injured dozens, with firefighters battling blazes in multiple countries including Belgium and France. The fires have intensified due to dry conditions and high temperatures, prompting emergency responses and raising concerns about climate-related disasters.

sources.headline: Firefighters battle wildfire tearing through Belgian nature reserve
Hundreds of villagers evacuate as Belgium battles record wildfire

europe_now.title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
europe_now.summary: Liechtenstein has amended its constitution to permit female succession to the throne, ending centuries of male-only inheritance. The change reflects broader European trends toward gender equality in monarchical systems.

sources.headline: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne

top_stories.title: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
top_stories.summary: France's highest court has rejected a proposed ban on social media use for children under 15, ruling that such restrictions would be disproportionate. The decision comes amid ongoing debates about digital rights and youth protection in the EU.

sources.headline: France’s top court rejects social media ban for under-15s

top_stories.title: EU carmakers face existential threat from Chinese competition
top_stories.summary: European automakers are struggling to compete with Chinese manufacturers, drawing comparisons to Nokia's decline in the mobile phone market. Industry experts warn that without significant innovation and support, EU carmakers risk losing global market share.
